name: My Lovely Mime: Silent Affair
source:
Eleven nights. One locked room behind the curtains. And a mime who says the most when she is silent.

You take a temporary backstage job at an old circus, expecting a quiet shift and easy money. Then you meet Mira — the star mime: playful onstage, guarded off it, and already tied to someone else.

A glance during rehearsal becomes a private joke. A joke becomes a secret invitation. Soon you are helping Mira prepare her own show while your hidden relationship grows more dangerous with every performance. She wants freedom, recognition, and the courage to stop living behind a mask — but every choice can bring her closer to you, push her back toward her boyfriend, or leave all three of you with nothing.

My Lovely Mime: Silent Affair is a story-driven adult visual novel about desire, ambition, guilt, trust, and the price of finally being seen.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4978030/My_Lovely_Mime_Silent_Affair/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
十一个夜晚，一间隐于帷幕之后的上锁房间，还有一位越是沉默便越是千言万语的哑剧女演员。

你在一家老旧马戏团接了份临时后台杂工，本以为只是清闲值班、轻松赚点外快，却在那里遇见了当家哑剧明星米拉——台上的她俏皮灵动，台下的她戒心重重，而且身边早已有了正牌男友。

排练时的一记对视化作了心照不宣的私密玩笑，一句玩笑又演变成了隐秘的邀约。很快，你便开始协助米拉筹备她的个人专场演出，而你们暗地里的地下情也随着每一场登台谢幕变得愈发危险。她渴望自由、渴望认可，也渴望鼓起不再躲在面具后苟活的勇气——可你的每一次抉择，都可能让她与你贴得更近、将她推回男友身边，或是让你们三人落得两手空空。

《我可爱的哑剧女郎：无声偷情》是一部剧情驱动型成人视觉小说，探讨欲望、野心、罪恶感、信任，以及终于被人真正看见所要付出的代价。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4978030/My_Lovely_Mime_Silent_Affair/]Steam[/url]]
